chars.YASSINE: a 19-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair, wearing an oversized olive-green hoodie with white drawstrings, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.STUDIO GUY: a 25-year-old Moroccan man with a sharp skin-fade haircut and a thin beard, wearing a white tracksuit with red side stripes, a shiny gold chain, sunglasses pushed up on his head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE sits on the bed of his small Casablanca bedroom at night, hopeful and excited, holding a notebook full of lyrics and a cheap USB microphone, posters on the wall, warm lamp light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE stands in his bedroom emptying his wallet into his palm, only a few small coins fall out, he looks worried and disappointed

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: a lively popular neighbourhood street in Casablanca in the afternoon, YASSINE leans on a wall with friends and looks with curiosity at STUDIO GUY who stands in the middle of a group of young men talking loudly

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: a tiny makeshift music studio in a room on a Moroccan rooftop terrace: foam and old blankets nailed on the walls, a microphone with a pop filter, a laptop and small speakers on a plastic table, satellite dishes and laundry lines visible through the open door

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: STUDIO GUY steps out of the rooftop studio door showing off, chin up, adjusting his gold chain with a proud smug smile, posing like a star

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: on the rooftop, several neighbourhood young men crowd around STUDIO GUY, smiling too much and flattering him, one offers him a soda, he looks pleased and important

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE stands apart at the edge of the rooftop with his arms crossed, shaking his head with a proud skeptical face, refusing to join the flatterers in the background

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: at sunset on the rooftop, YASSINE hesitates nervously holding his lyrics notebook, staring at STUDIO GUY who stands in the studio doorway, tense uncertain moment
